sections.name: Verse 1
lines: By Christ redeemed, In Christ restored,
And show the death of our dear Lord,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: His broken body in our stead Is here,
And so our feeble love is fed,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: His life blood shed for us we see;
The wine shall tell the mystery,

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: And thus that dark betrayal night,
The shame, the glory, by this rite,
